catkin.note: Convert package.xml and CMakeLists.txt; ament_python is a build type, not an installable ROS package.

roscpp.note: Port node, publisher, subscriber and parameter APIs.

rospy.note: Port Python node APIs; use the target Python 3.8 interpreter.

roslaunch.note: Rewrite ROS 1 launch syntax and node executable names.

rviz.note: Port RViz configuration and custom plugins.

rosbag.note: Use ros2 bag; ROS 1 bag format is not the default ROS 2 format.

actionlib.note: Use ROS 2 action APIs; not a source-compatible replacement.

actionlib_msgs.note: Redesign ROS 1 action status/id use; do not blindly rename message types.

message_runtime.note: Declare interface runtime dependencies in package.xml.

gazebo_ros_control.note: Optional simulation, not the default Pico hardware environment. Port plugins and URDF; Gazebo Classic and newer Gazebo are different targets.

gazebo.note: Optional simulation. The simulator is a system dependency, not a ROS package rename.
